card.name: Leading digit of split dose numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 4 or 7) that starts a multi-digit number split into separate pieces, in dose tables and dosing text. It comes right before the rest of the number, such as 1,050 mg, 150 or 100/25 mcg.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: A leading digit starting a dose in mg or mcg, split from the rest of the number.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage <<1>> mg orally once daily 1.5

modes.label: Strengths and thresholds
modes.description: A leading digit in a product strength, a duration or a limit.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a dose number that is written in pieces, as in dosing tables.
